Anna C: Heads up — ACME renewal stuck because their procurement portal rejects our PO. Error: 'Vendor EIN does not match registered entity'. They need signed PO by EOD. Can marketplace/finance/legal weigh in?
Mike R: Which marketplace? AWS or Azure?
Anna C: AWS Marketplace (private offer). PO id 4762. Customer: Acme Robotics
Jess L: @Mike R I can pull the PO payload. Getting error from AWS: 400 validation EIN mismatch. Likely our billing entity is 'Redwood Inference Inc' vs 'Redwood Inference LLC' in portal.
Sourav P: We recently updated vendor alias mapping — quick check: our ledger uses EIN 12-3456789 under 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' Provide snippet of PO (redacted).
Anna C: ```
{ "po_id": "4762", "vendor": "Redwood Inference, Inc.", "ein": "12-3456789", "amount": "$120,000" }
```
Finance Bot: FYI: We have EIN change request pending with AR team, ticket #FIN-9083. If urgent, finance can issue manual invoice but marketplace requires PO.
Jess L: Legal, any chance to accept 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' vs 'LLC' mismatch? Customer insists on exact match.
legal-team: Short answer: marketplace contracts require exact legal entity match for tax/PO reasons. We can prepare an LOA but need AR approval. @Anna C please forward the customer's legal contact.
Anna C: Sent contact. Also customer asked if a W9 + attestation would unblock the portal.
legal-team: W9 helps for verification but AWS gating still blocks when entity string mismatches. We'll escalate with AWS rep if finance confirms EIN + entity. @Finance Bot can you expedite FIN-9083?
Finance Bot: Escalating to AR ops now. ETA ~4 hours. If they need immediate access, we can provision a temporary credit hold with Sales signoff.
Mike R: I'll spin up a fallback private offer under our 'Redwood Inference LLC' alias as a one-off canary. If FIN confirms, we'll switch back. @Jess L can you coordinate with marketplace ops to avoid duplicate billing issues?
Jess L: On it. Opening AWS support case (case# 123456789) and ticketing marketplace ops. Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/home?caseId=123456789 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Anna C: Thanks — please post updates. If AWS confirms entity change, we need the resubmitted PO by 5pm PT to meet renewal date.
